summary: Iteration 18 (both) verified the delete-account 404 bug fix end-to-end. BACKEND (pytest 5/5 PASS): health, DELETE /api/account auth guards (401 no-token/bad-token), premium regression (delivered@resend.dev login 200 + is_premium intact), and a full throwaway lifecycle on delete-me@resend.dev: OTP auto-register -> /auth/me 200 -> POST /account/reset ok (reset-journey regression) -> deletion OTP send (should_create_user=false) -> wrong code 400 'Invalid code' with account NOT deleted -> correct code -> DELETE /api/account 200 {ok:true} -> both old/new tokens 401 -> user doc gone from mongo -> password login 401 -> same email re-registers as a FRESH user (new id, is_premium=false) -> cleanup delete. FRONTEND (Playwright, 375x667, public preview): Settings -> Delete Account -> type DELETE -> 'Delete Forever' -> OTP step 'Verify Your Identity' shows the account email (UI send via shim -> /api/auth/otp/send succeeded, NO 404) -> wrong code 0000 -> 'Invalid Code' alert shown, stays on OTP step, account intact -> correct code -> 'Account Deleted' success screen (checklist render) -> auto-cleanup -> redirect to /onboarding splash -> hera_token cleared from localStorage. No 'Deletion Failed' alert, no 404, zero app console errors (only pre-existing RNW deprecation warnings). profile.tsx:446 confirmed using api('/account',{method:'DELETE'}); no FunctionsHttpError / functions.invoke('delete-account') left in profile.tsx.

minor.issue: Deletes USER_COLLECTIONS (journal, goals, coach_messages, favorites, activities) + soft-deletes files + user doc, but does NOT delete otp_log entries for the user's email (housekeeping only; otp_log is rate-limit bookkeeping and OTPs themselves are deleted on verify). Harmless.

action_items: No required fixes - the 404 delete-account bug is verified FIXED end-to-end (UI + API + DB + post-delete auth rejection + fresh re-registration).

critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified in code: profile.tsx handleVerifyAndDelete (line 438-450) verifies OTP via shim -> /api/auth/otp/verify then calls api('/account', { method: 'DELETE' }) which throws ApiError with server detail on failure (src/api.ts:24-45). No Supabase edge-function invoke remains in profile.tsx; FunctionsHttpError import gone.

Shim correctness: emergent-client.ts signInWithOtp -> POST /api/auth/otp/send (honors shouldCreateUser:false -> 404 for unknown email), verifyOtp -> POST /api/auth/otp/verify and setSession(new token), so the subsequent DELETE /account runs with the fresh token - works because verify does not rotate user id.

Auto-cleanup (profile.tsx:467-477): 2.8s timer -> AsyncStorage.clear() -> resetOnboardingProgress() -> logout() (secureRemove hera_token - confirmed null after run) -> router.replace('/onboarding'). Verified live: final URL /onboarding, token cleared.

Server-side delete_account (server.py:325-331) deletes the user doc, so user_from_token 401s for ALL outstanding tokens of that user (verified for both pre- and post-OTP tokens) - correct invalidation strategy without a token blocklist.

OTP rate limit (5 sends/10min per email, server.py:767-769) surfaced correctly in the UI as 'Too many codes requested. Please try again in a few minutes' alert during testing - error propagation through the shim works.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (full delete E2E incl. negative OTP path, success screen, redirect, token cleanup)

rca_of_issue: ORIGINAL BUG: delete-account flow called supabase.functions.invoke('delete-account') which 404'd. FIX VERIFIED: profile.tsx now calls DELETE /api/account (server.py:325) after OTP re-verification; returns {ok:true}, deletes user + user collections, soft-deletes files. Reproduction of fixed flow: Settings -> Delete Account -> type DELETE -> Delete Forever -> 4-digit OTP -> Verify & Delete -> 'Account Deleted' -> /onboarding. Verified no 404/Deletion Failed at any step; wrong OTP shows 'Invalid Code' without deleting; post-delete all tokens 401 and the email re-registers as a fresh account.
